report.root_cause: plugins/TownCore/config.yml was edited at 08:16:42 so that economy.starting-balance was the string "100 coins" instead of an integer. When TownCore's tick reloaded the config, validation failed (IllegalArgumentException) and the plugin disabled itself at 08:16:44.
report.actions: 1) Watched status and found TownCore DISABLED. Read the log and found the config validation stack trace. 2) Declared an incident. 3) Edited plugins/TownCore/config.yml to set economy.starting-balance: 100 (an integer). Left everything else as it was, including currency: coins and the Season 3 welcome message. 4) Tried 'towncore reload' (unknown command). There is no plugin manager that can re-enable a disabled plugin, so I restarted the server once. 5) Checked the result: TownCore loaded and enabled cleanly, both players reconnected, TPS is 20, and no new errors after more than 60 s of watching.
report.residual_risk: Whoever edited the config may write a non-integer value again. They should know starting-balance must be a plain integer (currency is set separately). TownCore disables itself on a bad config instead of keeping the last good one, and it has no reload command, so any future config mistake will need another restart.
